title: Catapult Cats
one_line_rule: Drag down and back from the cat to aim — the dots show the arc — then release to launch.

brief.intent: Angry Birds style physics game where I launch cats at a tower of cardboard boxes
brief.notes: Drag to aim and release, gravity-driven arc and falling boxes. Give players a visible trajectory when aiming. Boxes must fall when hit and the goal must be attainable.
